The plate is a square plate about 340 px wide, which I take as roughly 24 cm, so about 14 px per cm.

Each corn piece is about 100 px across, or roughly 7 cm in diameter, which is a bit large for a corn cob slice. The cross-section is about 6-7 cm and the pieces look about 3-4 cm thick.

Volume of each piece: π × 3.25² × 3.5 ≈ 116 cm³. The cob is partly dense core, so I'll take about 0.9 g/cm³, giving roughly 100 g per piece. That puts the two pieces at about 200 g.
